facts.fact: MISA Regional's analysis says Zimbabwe has recently launched its National AI Strategy 2026-2030.

MISA Regional says the strategy's governance names the AI Strategy Implementation Office (AISIO) as central coordinating body, with a Steering Committee housed within POTRAZ and the President-chaired National Digital Regulatory Committee.

facts.fact: MISA Regional says the 2021 Cyber and Data Protection Act designates the Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ) as the data protection authority.
MISA Regional says Zimbabwe enacted the Cyber and Data Protection Act in 2021, which it describes as providing guidance on collection, storage, use and transfer of personal data.
MISA Regional says the Act designates POTRAZ as the data protection authority.
MISA Regional says Zimbabwe enacted the Cyber and Data Protection Act in 2021 and treats it as the operating data protection framework.
MISA Regional says Zimbabwe is a signatory to the Malabo Convention but is among 39 African countries that have not ratified it.
